description: Core-owned contract files vendored byte-for-byte from redact-secret/redact-secret at an immutable 40-hex commit. The adapters qualify by replaying them through their own public API (packages/adapter-ai-context/test/conformance*.test.ts, packages/adapter-mcp/test/conformance*.test.ts). The MCP fixtures are replayed by the core's own runners (mcp-boundary.mjs, which imports ai-context-boundary.mjs, and mcp-resources-read.mjs, which imports both), vendored with them, so the adapter is checked by exactly the code that defines the contract. Never edit a vendored file here: to move the pin, copy the file from the new core commit, then update commit and sha256 below. packages/adapter-ai-context/test/core-pins.test.ts fails when a file and its recorded digest disagree. Biome ignores this directory so the bytes stay exactly the core's.
